items.text: Remove the printer from Printers & scanners settings and then reinstall it.
items.evidence: Try removing and reinstalling your printer.

items.text: Restart the PC to refresh services and components needed for printer communication.
items.evidence: Restarting your PC can sometimes help to refresh the services and components necessary for your device to communicate with your printer.

items.text: Clear the Pause Printing and Use Printer Offline options in the printer queue on Windows 10.
items.evidence: Select Printer, then select Set As Default Printer, and clear Pause Printing and Use Printer Offline if they are selected.
